verdicts.title: Cobordisms and commutative categorial grammars
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We propose a concrete surface representation of abstract categorial grammars in the category of word cobordisms or cowordisms for short, which are certain bipartite graphs decorated with words in a given alphabet, generalizing linear logic proof-nets. We also introduce and study linear logic grammars, directly based on cobordisms and using classical multiplicative linear logic as a typing system.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns 'word cobordisms' as a surface representation of categorial grammars typed by linear logic, with no mention of torsors, CNF formulas, or circuit depth. It shares only loose categorical vocabulary with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Conjunctive categorial grammars and Lambek grammars with additives
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A new family of categorial grammars is proposed, defined by enriching basic categorial grammars with a conjunction operation. It is proved that the formalism obtained in this way has the same expressive power as conjunctive grammars, that is, context-free grammars enhanced with conjunction. verdicts.title: Classical linear logic, cobordisms and categorial grammars
